name: recoil_state_credits_on_try_become_current
description: RecoilStateCredits::OnTryBecomeCurrent allocates and constructs the credits panel, stores it as the dialog, enables it through the recovered ftable slot, and returns 1.
known_limits: VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs compiles the production source but does not reproduce the original EH-framed allocation cleanup shape: the first attempt generated a 48-byte function versus the original 106-byte function, with 97 unmasked byte mismatches.
functional_evidence: Native smoke runs the real credits-panel constructor in an empty temp directory, isolates the required option/video globals, and verifies return 1, non-null stored dialog, non-null dialog vptr, and enabled state set on the allocated dialog.
VC5SP3 byte verification was reviewed and left tier S pending because the current modeled Constructor method does not generate the original new-expression EH scaffold.
